exposure: Hospitals implementing the MOTIVE treatment bundle
outcome: Initiation of all MOTIVE bundle components within 20 minutes
cohort: Women experiencing postpartum haemorrhage managed by healthcare workers in hospitals in Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, and South Africa participating in the E-MOTIVE trial.
finding: E-MOTIVE care hospitals achieved faster initiation of all PPH treatment components (median 13 min) compared to usual care (median 18 min), and a higher proportion of women (79%) received all components within 20 minutes compared to usual care (22%).
